description: A Stripe Customer Portal link for your company: payment method, invoices and cancellation. To cancel, call it with cancel: true (and companies: "all" for every company you own): that changes nothing and answers the companies, a warning to read to the person, and a confirmation_id. Only after they say yes, call it again with just the confirmation_id for one cancellation link per company. billing_not_enabled until billing starts; free_plan for a company on RepuTend's free plan, which has no portal. (capability: billing.portal_own)

cancel.description: Ask to cancel: answers the warning and a confirmation_id, and changes nothing.

companies.description: With cancel: every company you own, instead of one.

company.description: The company to act for, by its domain (for example aioseo.com), one of those list_companies shows. Needed only when your key reaches more than one company.

confirmation_id.description: The id the cancel call answered, alone, after the person said yes.

name: billing_portal_link
